versions.changelog: Patch: added Example Prompts and Install-First Success Path to SKILL.md; added Clean Scan Evidence and Install-First Success Path to ACCEPTANCE.md. No functional changes.

Initial release of Weekly Meal Rhythm Planner.

- Generates simple 7-day meal rhythm cards for steadier eating habits.
- Focuses on practical, flexible planning without calorie tracking or strict menus.
- Guides users to identify meal anchors, fallback meals, and prep tasks based on their routines and constraints.
- Includes a built-in safety boundary: does not provide medical or individualized nutrition advice.
- Outputs a concise planner card with week map, anchors, fallback meals, prep list, review prompt, and safety note.
